selected_first_decision.activity_source: VAD opens and updates one interruption candidate
selected_first_decision.decision_source: Attributed STT text decides meaningful speech versus completed filler-only speech
selected_first_decision.future_acoustic_provider: Deferred to a separate accepted amendment

delivery_order: Neutral VAD activity and immutable segment attribution
Overlap coordinator and bounded STT gate

mode_table.decision: Commit after all enabled duration and word thresholds pass
mode_table.negative_result: Speech ends before eligibility; suppress only if it overlapped assistant output

mode_table.decision: VAD opens the candidate; attributed STT commits interruption after meaningful-word and duration eligibility
mode_table.negative_result: Only VAD end can commit filler-only or short transcriptless activity as backchannel

mode_table.decision: Use VAD mode for the session when playout or STT attribution is unavailable

threshold_semantics.positive_combination: All nonzero duration and meaningful-word thresholds must pass
threshold_semantics.min_duration: Voiced audio duration from detector evidence, never wall-clock silence or queue residence
threshold_semantics.min_words: Count of recognized non-filler words over attributed held transcript; zero disables word gating
threshold_semantics.transcriptless_safety: Below min_duration at VAD end is backchannel; at or above min_duration is inconclusive and fails toward interruption
threshold_semantics.legacy_vad: min_duration=0 and min_words=0 unless new values are explicitly configured
threshold_semantics.legacy_word: mode=vad, min_duration=0 and min_words=1 unless new values are explicitly configured

transcript_decision_contract.comparison: Unicode case folding, punctuation removal and whitespace collapsing over attributed STT
transcript_decision_contract.filler_only_partial: Remains pending because later text may establish intent
transcript_decision_contract.filler_only_final: Commits backchannel only after matching VAD end
transcript_decision_contract.mixed_example: um please stop is interruption because it contains non-filler words
transcript_decision_contract.ownership: Coordinator owns decision and transcript disposition; STT only supplies attributed evidence

identity_contract.audio_segment: Assigned before asynchronous VAD/STT provider work and immutable through callbacks
identity_contract.overlap: Created by the coordinator for one segment intersecting one response playout epoch
identity_contract.response: Carried from assistant audio message through queue, sink handoff and terminal output event
identity_contract.decision_revision: Incremented when an overlap closes or is replaced
identity_contract.late_data: Resolved only through a bounded closed-segment disposition; never rebound to current context

activity_contract.producer_rule: One shared tracker wraps all VAD implementations so timing and reset behavior are consistent
activity_contract.forbidden: VAD cannot rotate context or emit model, TTS or channel cancellation

playout_contract.completion: A sealed response reaches one terminal state after all response-owned queued and in-flight work is retired
playout_contract.underrun: Temporary empty queue is not terminal
playout_contract.atomicity: Snapshot and subscription ordering cannot miss a transition between the two operations
playout_contract.meaning: Local sink evidence only, not proof of remote human reception

transcript_gate_contract.stt_first: First attributed STT may open the overlap before VAD delivery when matching playout exists
transcript_gate_contract.positive: One resolution claim commits lifecycle and directly replays held STT exactly once to the immutable committed context
transcript_gate_contract.negative: Discard current and late packets for that closed segment until retention expiry
transcript_gate_contract.inconclusive_or_error: Fail toward user input and replay once
transcript_gate_contract.overflow: Safety override; fail toward user input including the packet that crossed the bound
transcript_gate_contract.eos: EOS sees overlap evidence only after coordinator resolution

supported_after_implementation: WebRTC after response identity survives buffering, pacing and final sink write
Direct socket telephony paths using shared MediaSession after response-aware frame and terminal semantics
unsupported: SIP while the downstream RTP queue is unobserved
Plain gRPC output without a server-owned sink
Text mode, disconnected output and transfer-owned output

test_matrix: VAD start/progress/end has one immutable segment ID across each provider
Stream stall and detector reset do not fabricate voiced duration
Legacy current and older keys have deterministic precedence
STT-first and VAD-first delivery resolve the same overlap
Filler-only partial remains pending and can become meaningful interruption
Case and punctuation variants match the approved filler phrases
Mixed filler and meaningful words commit interruption
Short transcriptless activity is backchannel and eligible transcriptless activity fails toward interruption
Negative resolution suppresses a late final for the same segment but not the next segment
Positive resolution replays held STT directly and exactly once to its committed context
Overflow, timeout, STT error and inconclusive result preserve user input
EOS cannot commit while the overlap coordinator owns pending evidence
Playback snapshot/subscription cannot miss start or terminal events
Temporary underrun does not end local playout
Stale output epoch cannot reactivate or clear a newer response
Transcript mode is unavailable on SIP and plain gRPC in the initial scope
Existing greeting protection and uninterrupted conversation behavior remain unchanged
blocked_on: Exact direct-telephony transport paths after coordinator inventory review
Measured decision deadline and bounded STT gate limits
Maintainer approval of the initial filler phrase set and new defaults
Second independent challenge with no unresolved critical or major findings
